title: RiskLayer
description: One natural-catastrophe hazard layer scored for an address.

layerId.description: Hazard layer identifier. Observed values are `FL_Fluvial_SwissRe` (river flood) and `FL_Surge_SwissRe` (coastal storm surge); the `_SwissRe` suffix identifies Swiss Re as the hazard data source.

valueLabel.description: Human-readable hazard value. Observed values include `Outside` (outside the modelled hazard zone) and return-period labels such as `50 years`.

intensity.description: Hazard intensity as a decimal string. Observed `1` through `8.9`.

riskIndex.description: Numeric risk band the tool maps to a CSS class (`risk-<n>`). Observed values 1 and 7; the tool renders a graduated bar from this value.

riskDescription.description: Risk band label the tool renders as "<value> Risk". Observed values `Low` and `High`. When absent/empty the tool renders "No Risk Data".

details.description: A JSON document embedded as a string (double-encoded, CRLF-formatted) carrying the underlying Swiss Re model attributes for the layer - e.g. `FF Return Period (SR)`, `FF Protection (SR)`, `FF Schema (SR)`, `FF Code (SR)`, `FF Frequency (SR)` for fluvial flood, and `Surge Return Period` for storm surge. Consumers must parse this string as JSON.

version.description: Layer data version. Observed `/v1/` on every layer.
